title: Ramsey number R(7,13), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_7 and no blue K_13; it shows R(7,13) > n. The best known lower bound is R(7,13) >= 513, so a colouring of K_512 is known and one of K_513 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(7,13) >= 513: NaRT repository, 22 Oct 2026; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 511; read 5 Nov 2026

provenance.keeper: Small Ramsey Numbers (S. Radziszowski), EJC Dynamic Survey DS1
provenance.revision: revision 18 (24 Apr 2026) and later sources named

score: n, the number of vertices of the colouring; it proves R(7,13) >= n + 1 (larger is better)
